description_zh: 调用此接口并提供音视频ID即可获取播放地址，随后可使用阿里云播放器或第三方播放器（如系统原生、开源或自研播放器）播放音视频内容

name: GetPlayInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audio or video file. You can specify only one ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
For an audio or video file uploaded in the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Library > Audio/Video to view the ID.
When you upload an audio or video file by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html operation, the ID is the value of the VideoId response parameter.
After an audio or video file is uploaded, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html operation to query the ID, which is the value of the VideoId response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
音/视频ID，仅支持传入单个音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录视频点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55407.html接口上传音/视频时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86044.html接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: video_id

parameters.help_en:
The format of the media stream. Separate multiple formats with commas (,). Valid values:

mp4
m3u8
mp3
flv
mpd


By default, streams of all formats are retrieved.
The mpd format is output only when the dash container format is configured in the transcoding template. For more information, refer to [Container: container format](~~52839#title-7rr-3hj-gy5~~)
parameters.help_zh:
媒体流格式。多个格式之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

mp4
m3u8
mp3
flv
mpd


默认获取所有格式的流。
mpd格式仅当转码模板中配置了`dash`封装格式时才会输出。更多详情，请参见[Container：封装格式](~~52839#title-7rr-3hj-gy5~~)
parameters.name: formats

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the playback URL. Unit: seconds.

When OutputType is set to cdn:

    - The playback URL expires periodically only if URL authentication is enabled. Otherwise, the URL is permanently valid. For more information about how to enable and configure URL authentication, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86090.html.
    - Minimum value: 1.
    - Maximum value: unlimited.
    - Default value: If this parameter is not specified, the default validity period configured for URL authentication is used.

When OutputType is set to oss:

    - The playback URL expires periodically only if the storage permission is set to private. Otherwise, the URL is permanently valid.
    - Minimum value: 1.
    - Maximum value: To reduce security risks of the origin server, the maximum value is 604800 (7 days) when the audio or video file is stored in an ApsaraVideo VOD bucket, and 129600 (36 hours) when the file is stored in a user-owned OSS bucket. If the maximum value does not meet your requirements, you can set OutputType to cdn and configure URL authentication to set a longer validity period.
    - Default value: If this parameter is not specified, the value is 3600
parameters.help_zh:
设置播放地址的有效时间。单位：秒。

当OutputType取值为cdn时：

    - 只有开启了URL鉴权，播放地址才会定期失效，否则会永久有效。URL鉴权的开启及配置方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86090.html。
    - 最小值：1。
    - 最大值：无限制。
    - 默认值：未设置时，取值为URL鉴权中设置的默认有效时长。

当OutputType取值为oss时：

    - 只有存储权限为私有，播放地址才会定期失效，否则会永久有效。
    - 最小值：1。
    - 最大值：为降低源站安全风险，当音视频存储在点播系统Bucket上时，最大值为604800（即7天），当音视频存储在OSS自有Bucket上时，最大值为129600（即36小时）。如果此处设置的最大值不能满足您的需求，您可以设置OutputType为cdn，通过设置URL鉴权来设置更长的有效期。
    - 默认值：未设置时，取值为3600
parameters.name: auth_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The type of the output URL. Valid values:

oss: the back-to-origin URL.
cdn (default): the accelerated URL
parameters.help_zh:
输出地址类型。取值：

oss：回源地址。
cdn（默认）：加速地址
parameters.name: output_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the media stream. Separate multiple types with commas (,). Valid values:

video: video.
audio: audio.

By default, streams of all types are retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
媒体流类型。多个类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持类型：

video：视频。
audio：音频。

默认获取所有类型的流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en: The CDN reauthentication parameter, which is a JSON string. When type A signing of URL authentication is enabled, you can use this parameter to set the uid and rand values of the authenticated URL. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2249352.html
parameters.help_zh: CDN二次鉴权参数，为JSON字符串。当开启了URL鉴权的A方式鉴权功能时，可通过该参数设置鉴权URL的`uid`和`rand`，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2249352.html
parameters.name: re_auth_info

parameters.help_en:
The definition of the video stream. Separate multiple definitions with commas (,). Valid values:

FD: fluent.
LD: standard definition.
SD: high definition.
HD: ultra-high definition.
OD: original definition.
2K: 2K.
4K: 4K.
SQ: standard sound quality.
HQ: high sound quality.
AUTO: adaptive bitrate.

By default, streams of all definitions are retrieved.
When a tracing watermark is generated, this parameter is required and must be consistent with the definition configured for tracing watermark transcoding.
The AUTO format is output only when transcoding packaging is configured in the transcoding template. For more information, refer to [PackageSetting: transcoding packaging settings](~~52839#title-4fk-cg8-gzx~~)
parameters.help_zh:
视频流清晰度。多个清晰度之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。取值：

FD：流畅。
LD：标清。
SD：高清。
HD：超清
OD：原画。
2K：2K。
4K：4K。
SQ：普通音质。
HQ：高音质。
AUTO：自适应码率。

默认获取所有清晰度的流。
生成溯源水印时，本参数必填，需与溯源水印转码时所设置的清晰度保持一致。
AUTO格式仅当转码模板中配置了转码打包时才会有该清晰度输出，请参见[PackageSetting：转码打包设置](~~52839#title-4fk-cg8-gzx~~)
parameters.name: definition

parameters.help_en:
The type of the returned data. Valid values:

Single (default): returns only the latest transcoded stream for each definition and format.
Multiple: returns all transcoded streams for each definition and format
parameters.help_zh:
返回数据类型。取值：

Single（默认）：每种清晰度和格式只返回一路最新转码完成的流。
Multiple：每种清晰度和格式返回所有转码完成的流
parameters.name: result_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom playback settings. The value is a JSON string. You can specify the domain name for playback. For more information about how to construct the parameter, refer to [PlayConfig](~~86952#section-9g7-s9b-v7z~~).

If PlayConfig is not specified or the PlayDomain field in PlayConfig is not specified, the operation uses the default domain name configured in ApsaraVideo VOD by default. If no default domain name is configured, the operation queries domain names in descending order of modification time and uses the most recently modified domain name as the playback domain name. To prevent an unexpected domain name from being returned, we recommend that you configure a default playback domain name. You can log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Asset Management Configuration > Storage Management > Manage > Domain Names that Route Back-to-origin Traffic to This Storage Address to configure the default playback domain name.
When the EncryptType parameter in PlayConfig is set to AliyunVoDEncryption, the playback URL of the private encrypted stream is not returned by default to ensure video security. To return the playback URL of the private encrypted stream, you must also set the ResultType parameter to Multiple
parameters.help_zh:
播放自定义设置。为JSON字符串，支持指定域名播放设置。参数构造详情，请参见[PlayConfig](~~86952#section-9g7-s9b-v7z~~)。

PlayConfig不设置或者其中`PlayDomain`不设置时，接口默认使用点播配置的默认域名；如果没有设置默认域名，则会根据域名的修改时间倒序查询，使用最新修改过的域名作为播放域名。为防止返回的不是想要的域名，建议设置默认播放域名（可登录视频点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 存储管理 > 管理 > 回源到此存储地址的域名设置默认播放域名）。
当PlayConfig中的`EncryptType`参数设置为`AliyunVoDEncryption`时，为了保障您的视频安全，默认不返回私有加密流播放地址，若需要返回私有加密流播放地址，需要同时设置`ResultType`参数为`Multiple`
parameters.name: play_config

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the live comment mask data. Valid value: danmu.

This parameter takes effect only when OutputType is set to cdn
parameters.help_zh:
获取弹幕蒙版数据URL地址，取值：danmu。

仅当`outputType`取值为`cdn`时才会生效
parameters.name: addition_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom digital watermarking information.
When DigitalWatermarkType is set to TraceMark, you can pass this parameter to set the tracing watermark information for the video and return the video stream that contains the watermark information. Only English letters, digits, and Chinese characters are supported. A maximum of 1,024 characters are supported.
When DigitalWatermarkType is set to CopyrightMark, Trace corresponds to the Watermark Text set when the watermark template is created. By passing this parameter, you can query and return the video stream with the specified watermark text
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义的数字水印信息。
当`DigitalWatermarkType`取值为`TraceMark`时，通过传入本参数，可以为视频设置溯源水印的水印信息，并返回包含水印信息的视频流。仅支持传入英文字母、数字及中文字符，最多支持1024个字符。
当`DigitalWatermarkType`取值为`CopyrightMark`时，`Trace`对应创建水印模板时所设置的水印文字。通过传入本参数，可以查询并返回指定水印文字的视频流
parameters.name: trace

parameters.help_en:
The digital watermarking type. Valid values:

TraceMark: tracing watermark.
CopyrightMark: copyright watermark
parameters.help_zh:
数字水印类型。取值：

TraceMark：溯源水印。
CopyrightMark：版权水印
parameters.name: digital_watermark_type

parameters.help_en: The custom ID. The ID must be 6 to 64 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The ID must be unique per user
parameters.help_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
parameters.name: reference_id

The URL of the thumbnail for the audio or video file.
If you need to obtain the thumbnail URL in real time after a video is uploaded, you can configure an ApsaraVideo VOD callback. For more information, refer to [HTTP callbacks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67214.html） and [Video snapshot completion event]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57337.html）

音/视频封面地址。
如果上传完视频后需要实时获取音/视频封面地址，您可以配置点播回调，详情请参见[HTTP回调]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67214.html）及[视频截图完成事件]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57337.html）

DanMuURL.description_en: The URL of the live comment mask data

Status.description_zh: 音/视频状态。各取值及描述，请参见[Status：音视频状态](~~52839#title-vqg-8cz-7p8~~)

SourceArchive: archive for mezzanine files.
